title: Evaluation-normalized signed extension of the fixed finite Tate comparison
statement:
Fix $k,\ell,E,n,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions], put $m=\ell^n$, $R=\mathbf Z/m$, and let $X$ be any $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Set $L_X=\mu^{e}_{m,X}\otimes_R A_X$ on its small etale site; let $L_X(r)$ be the integer tensor/dual powers of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Let $A_X(r)$ be the specified pro-etale twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], and $\nu_X$ the site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $c_{m,X}$ be the same-root map of [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison] and $\theta_X:A_X(1)\cong\mu^{p}_{m,X}\otimes_R A_X$ the projection-induced identification of [def-pur-frame-class]. For $r\geq0$ fix the comparison $q^+_{X,r}:\nu_X^*L_X(r)\cong A_X(r)$ of [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent], with $q^+_{X,1}=\theta_X^{-1}(c_{m,X}\otimes1)$ and the coefficient-unit map in degree zero.

For $d>0$ let $q_{X,-d}$ be the evaluation-normalized dual extension of $q^+_{X,d}$, as in [lem-pur-signed-line-derived-base-change]. Thus, using sheaf tensor and Hom [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pur-sheaf-hom], it is characterized by
$$\operatorname{ev}_{A_X(d)}(q_{X,-d}\otimes q^+_{X,d})=\nu_X^*(\operatorname{ev}_{L_X(d)})$$
after tensor and coefficient-unit comparison. Put $q_{X,r}=q^+_{X,r}$ for $r\geq0$.

This dual extension is compatible with the specified mixed-sign multiplication of the Tate twists: for every $r,s\in\mathbf Z$, with $h^e,h^p$ their ordered multiplication maps,
$$q_{X,r+s}\nu_X^*h^e_{r,s}=h^p_{r,s}(q_{X,r}\otimes q_{X,s}).$$
For every scheme map $v:X'\to X$, write $\tau^e_{v,r},\tau^p_{v,r}$ for root-induced geometric pullback, using dual evaluation for negative powers, and let $k_v:v_p^*\nu_X^*\cong\nu_{X'}^*v_e^*$ be [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. The fixed nonnegative pullback square extends to negative integers with precisely these dual maps:
$$\tau^p_{v,r}v_p^*q_{X,r}=q_{X',r}\nu_{X'}^*(\tau^e_{v,r})k_v\qquad(r<0).$$
The extended squares respect identities, composition and dual evaluation. Finally the $r=1$ coefficient map $z\mapsto z\otimes1_A$ is carried by $q_{X,1}$ to the precise $\sigma_Xc_{m,X}$ of [def-pur-frame-class], where $\sigma_X(z)=\theta_X^{-1}(z\otimes1_A)$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-signed-twist-evaluation-extension] to b and its normalization. Retain its unique family q and evaluation equation. This is a strict dual-extension result, with none of the product, geometric or theta conclusions.
Apply [lem-pur-signed-twist-product-compatibility] to this same q and the assumed normalized intrinsic products mu.
Apply [lem-pur-signed-twist-geometric-compatibility] to q to obtain the geometric family with all four laws and its canonical negative square.

Prove the precise root coefficient equation directly. The projection from the infinite root tower is locally surjective by [lem-amb-root-tower-finite-tensor]. For a Cartier image of an etale root, pass to its image covering sieve and choose a local root-tower lift. The same-root comparison [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison] identifies its projection with the restricted etale root. The hypothesis hb in degree one then computes b on the etale tensor generator, and the hypothesis htheta computes theta on that pro-etale generator. Naturality and separatedness descend the equality. Apply theta inverse and its inverse identity. Agreement q(1)=b(1) proves exactly SignedSiteRootCoefficient.

Assemble the five conjunctions. Any other family satisfying them has the same prescribed nonnegative components and evaluation equation, so the uniqueness clause of the first result gives equality of the families.
